mentions.name: Elk Finder
mentions.description: A mapping web app similar to onX Hunt that provides specific layers for finding ideal elk habitat during September and October, the primary archery and rifle hunting months.
mentions.problem: Finding ideal elk habitat during the September and October archery and rifle hunting months.
mentions.source_excerpt: I spent the last 6 months building Elk Finder (https://elkfinder.com) and just launched a few weeks ago. It's a mapping web app similar to onX Hunt, except I have specific layers for finding ideal elk habitat in September and October (the primary archery and rifle hunting months).
mentions.author: jonnycoder
